prompts.level_1: Identify the immediate traversal, stealth, dialogue, interaction, weapon, combat, scan, quickhack, vehicle, braindance, consumable, or menu goal and preserve visible names and targets.
prompts.level_2: Summarize the quest phase, infiltration, conversation, combat, hacking, travel, investigation, or preparation sub-goal.
prompts.level_3: State the long-horizon quest, infiltration, investigation, relationship, combat, travel, or progression objective while preserving defining names and locations.
prompts.continuity: Merge dialogue, travel, infiltration, hacking, and combat when they advance the same quest or objective; split on a new quest, braindance/session transition, unrelated destination, major cutscene reset, or clear objective change.
